annotation.title_clean: ISO/AWI 25929 Ships and marine technology — Method to determine minimum safe lookout area for MASS
annotation.title_en: ISO/AWI 25929 Ships and marine technology — Method to determine minimum safe lookout area for MASS
annotation.summary_en: ISO catalogue page for ISO/AWI 25929, a standard in development (stage 20.00, April 2026) by ISO/TC 8/SC 26. It sets out how to define and determine the Minimum Safe Lookout Area for maritime autonomous surface ships (MASS). The aim is to support collision avoidance, situational awareness and remote operating centre requirements in a way that can be checked.
key_provisions_or_claims: Defines the Minimum Safe Lookout Area (MSLA): the area around a vessel within which unattended lookout is possible
Enables quantitative verification of situational awareness and of collision-avoidance decision-making
Covers bandwidth and display requirements when a remote operating centre is used
Accounts for variation in ship characteristics and environmental conditions
Applies to autonomous navigation systems or crew, whether onboard or at a remote operating centre
